An Evening Full of Vietnamese Flavors in the Heart of Thao Dien
May 2025 • Friends
We had a cozy and joyful evening at a restaurant right on Xuan Thuy Street, in the heart of Thao Dien. Despite the busy crowd, the food was served promptly, hot, and beautifully presented. The staff were extremely enthusiastic and attentive. Most notably, the dishes were rich in traditional Vietnamese flavors—delicious and full of cultural character—leaving a strong impression on everyone who tried them. An ideal spot for gathering with friends or hosting intimate parties.

Still one of my go-to spots in the area
May 2025 • Family
I’ve been to this restaurant three times now, and each time has been quite consistent. The food quality remains solid, and the flavors are well-balanced. This time, service was a bit slower than usual – possibly because it was the weekend and the place was quite busy. That said, the staff stayed polite and handled it professionally, even offering a kind apology. It’s still one of my favorite spots in the area, and I’ll definitely come back to try more dishes

A Visit to Hidden Charm – And Definitely Not the Last
May 2025 • Family
I had the chance to visit Hidden Charm on a quiet afternoon, and I was genuinely impressed — from the food to the ambiance. The dishes were well-prepared, full of flavor, and clearly made with care. Quality was consistent throughout, both in taste and presentation.

The space is airy and comfortable, with cool air conditioning that makes you want to linger a little longer. What stood out the most to me was the thoughtful interior design — every corner reflects the owner’s passion and attention to detail.

In the F&B world, places created with genuine heart always leave a lasting impression. Hidden Charm is exactly that kind of place.

I’ll definitely be coming back with friends in the near future. Great food, great atmosphere — absolutely worth sharing
